value.rationale: This is the complete first nontrivial five-vertex signed-graph quadratic hypersimplex code over the smallest evaluation field, not an arbitrary subproblem. Exact support multiplicities for all 13 weights refine minimum-distance and second-weight facts and give the complete weight enumerator relevant to error detection. The independent structural classification of every nowhere-zero quadratic torus evaluation is a natural algebraic boundary problem and yields three surprising and invariant signed-graph types, with a complete 62-orbit symmetry census. The result is valuable within the stated finite domain, with no unsupported assertion of family-wide impact.
